# Audit implementation completeness and correctness
- run a critical audit if the implementation is really 100% following the task and design specifation. Make sure, the ai agent did not leave out or simplified anything.
- 100% matching design specification and 100% follwing the task description.
- If verification is not passed:
- - Check if there is a real blocker why the implemention could not fullfil the task completely. Design could be flawed or tools could be missing. In that case write a clear warning in the task memo, describing the incomplete or incorrect implementation and explain the reasons and action necessary.
-- If there is no valid blocker, restart the task with a prompt injected, explaining why validation failed and asked to fix it.
